subject: stf
title: STF.------ACT.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-47. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'If I am correct, we will soon be moving into a period of confusion as to the very nature of what creative music is — not to mention the potential of creativity as a positive functional factor for transformation.' The crossing diagrams how structural-form structurally meets action at the confusion-of-creative-music scale: STF (structural-formal phenomenon — the form's actual structural-formal working) crossed with ACT (action — the partner-axis's working action). STF sits at upper-right with the subject-arrow; T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) and POL-DY (political dynamics) anchor the right margin as the subject-side downward chain. MT-INTR (meta-introduction) and DEF (definition) sit upper-center with PRI-INFO (principle information) at upper-left as the bridging-axis upper chain. CR-INFO-DY (creative-information dynamics) and ALT-C-PROG (alternative-creative progression) sit centrally as the bridging hubs. BIA (bias) and ACT at center-left as the partner-axis position with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) at center-right. PROJ-DY (projection dynamics) hangs at lower-center with AF-DY (affinity dynamics), POST (postulation), AF-CON (affinity convergence), and ATTN (attention) as the partner-side downward chain. Structural argument: when structural-form is crossed with action, the upper diagonal MT-INTR → DEF → PRI-INFO → BIA → ACT is the *confusion-route* — meta-introduction routes through definition into principle-information, then through bias into action on the partner-axis. The confusion the prose names is structurally that BIA intercepts principle-information's translation into action — without BIA, the chain would close at action directly, but in the confusion-cycle BIA pulls action into a biased form. CR-INFO-DY → ALT-C-PROG → PROG-CONT is the bridging route holding creative-information-dynamics into progressional-continuance. The partner-axis downward chain PROJ-DY → AF-DY → POST → AF-CON / ATTN is what action produces alone — projection-dynamics routes through affinity-dynamics into postulation and finally into affinity-convergence and attention. STF → T-C-IMP / POL-DY on the right is the subject-side output. The structural argument: the potential of creativity as positive transformation requires holding the PRI-INFO → CR-INFO-DY → ALT-C-PROG bridging chain so that structural-form reaches action *without* BIA intercepting; otherwise the form's structural-formal working terminates in the partner-side's attention-as-postulation alone.
